page_title: EMP 3-2 TOR | Empoli v Torino 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' 3 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Liberato Cacace, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to M'Baye Niang (Empoli), who beats Vanja Milinkovic-Savic with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
90+1' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Raoul Bellanova puts the ball on a plate for Duvan Zapata (Torino), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 2:2.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Karol Linetty is replaced by Adam Masina (Torino).
88' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) replaces Szymon Zurkowski.
87' Duvan Zapata (Torino) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
86' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
83' That's the end of the game for Ricardo Rodriguez, who is replaced by David Okereke (Torino).
83' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Samuele Ricci will be replaced by Matteo Lovato (Torino).

78' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
77' A substitution has been made. Mergim Vojvoda goes off and Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes on.
75' 2 - 1 Goal! Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is teed up on the edge of the box by Youssef Maleh, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 2:1.
73' Torino fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Empoli) leaps to collect the ball.
72' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
70' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replacing Nicolo Cambiaghi.
70' Here comes a substitution. Alberto Cerri is given a rest as he is replaced by M'Baye Niang (Empoli).
68' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

67' Duvan Zapata (Torino) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Torino win a corner kick.
67' Razvan Marin (Empoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Davide Massa interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Free kick. Torino will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
66' A lofted cross from Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
65' Giuseppe Pezzella is being substituted because of an injury. Davide Nicola sends Liberato Cacace (Empoli) on the pitch.
65' Today's match ends for Simone Bastoni who will be replaced by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
65' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' Duvan Zapata (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
62' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Torino have a corner.
60' 1 - 1 Duvan Zapata (Torino) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
60' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) will take the corner.
60' Duvan Zapata (Torino) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
57' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
55' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
53' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
52' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' The referee blows his whistle as Karol Linetty (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge.
47' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Massa no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Razvan Marin (Empoli) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
45+1' Razvan Marin (Empoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
41' Karol Linetty (Torino) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
41' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
41' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
39' Duvan Zapata (Torino) sees a yellow card from Davide Massa after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
36' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

36' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Elia Caprile easily makes the save.
33' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
31' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Today's referee Davide Massa rightly decides to book Alberto Cerri (Empoli) for his harsh tackle.
27' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
24' Duvan Zapata (Torino) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
23' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alberto Cerri (Empoli) heads on.
18' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Duvan Zapata (Torino) but poses no threat.

16' A short pass finds Antonio Sanabria (Torino). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
15' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
11' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
7' 1 - 0 Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
5' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Torino will kick the game off.
Davide Massa is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
